name: Notion
description: Notion is a connected workspace for documents, wikis, projects, and structured databases. Teams use it to write knowledge, organize operating information, track work, and collaborate on shared pages.
agentUseSummary: Connect Notion once, choose the pages to share, then select which agents may find and read content, prepare updates, create pages, or append blocks under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Find content
capabilities.description: Search a bounded set of pages and data sources shared with the Notion connection.

capabilities.label: Read pages
capabilities.description: Read one explicit Notion page and its shaped properties.

capabilities.label: Read page content
capabilities.description: Read one bounded page or block child list without automatic recursion.

capabilities.label: Prepare updates
capabilities.description: Prepare an exact page or block payload locally without changing Notion.

capabilities.label: Create pages
capabilities.description: Create one page under an explicit shared page or data source; data-source writes identify its title property.

capabilities.label: Append content
capabilities.description: Append a bounded block list to one explicit shared page or block.

allowed.label: Search content
allowed.description: Search a bounded set of accessible Notion pages and data sources.

allowed.label: Read a page
allowed.description: Read one explicit accessible Notion page.

allowed.label: Read page content
allowed.description: Read one bounded list of child blocks without automatic recursion.

allowed.label: Prepare an update
allowed.description: Prepare an exact page or block payload locally without changing Notion.

approvalRequired.label: Create a page
approvalRequired.description: Create one exact page under an explicit shared parent; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Append content
approvalRequired.description: Append an exact bounded block list to one explicit parent; Safe mode requires matching approval.

blocked.label: Change sharing
blocked.description: Workspace membership, page sharing, public publishing, and connection capability administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change schemas
blocked.description: Database and data-source schema changes are outside V1.

blocked.label: Delete or archive content
blocked.description: Deleting, archiving, restoring, moving, or bulk-changing content is outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Notion API calls
blocked.description: Raw URLs, arbitrary operations, credentials, unbounded traversal, and hidden-content inference are never exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded searches, reads, and local drafts run directly; each Notion write requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Notion operation supported by this connector runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, Notion-granted access, request bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six typed Notion tools and attaches the authorized workspace token server-side without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts six typed Notion tools and attaches the authorized workspace token server-side without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's public Notion connection, production callback, capabilities, client credentials, and a fresh production authorization have not been configured and verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a public Notion connection for any workspace, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/notion/callback, enable read content, insert content, and update content capabilities, configure NOTION_CLIENT_ID and NOTION_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then verify state, workspace binding, refresh, bounded reads, Safe write approval, Dangerous writes, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Notion documents internal static-token connections and public OAuth connections, exact redirect URIs, authorization-code exchange, workspace page selection, access and refresh tokens, and token refresh.
Notion documents bounded search over pages and data sources shared with a connection and requires bearer authentication plus a pinned Notion-Version header.
Notion documents page retrieval and page creation, with content represented by blocks and access constrained by connection capabilities and sharing.
Notion documents the current data-source model and explicit parent sharing boundary introduced after the database/data-source split.
Notion warns that search is not exhaustive or immediate; Relay therefore returns bounded results and never treats absence as proof that hidden content does not exist.
